facts.text: NavigationTrack-v0 is registered with entry point gym_navigation.envs.navigation_track:NavigationTrack
The action space is Discrete(3): one integer per Action enum member
The three actions are FORWARD (0, linear shift 0.2 m, angular 0), ROTATE_RIGHT (1, 0.04 m, 0.2 rad) and ROTATE_LEFT (2, 0.04 m, -0.2 rad)
The observation is five range measurements at -pi/2, -pi/4, 0, pi/4 and pi/2 from the heading
The scan range constants are 30.0 maximum and 0.2 minimum
The observation space is a Box of N_OBSERVATIONS = N_MEASUREMENTS (5) elements whose high and low are the scan range constants
The shift and sensor noise standard deviations are 0.02
Each action draws Gaussian noise N(0, 0.02) for the angular and the linear shift, moves the pose and then rotates it
Positions and ranges are in metres: the renderer maps 1 m to 20 pixels
The yaw is measured from the y axis in [-pi, pi], positive clockwise
The episode terminates when any scan range is below the collision threshold
The collision reward is -200.0, the forward reward +5.0 and the rotation reward -0.5
The reward is the collision reward on a collision, the forward reward for FORWARD and the rotation reward otherwise
A reset restores the world from the track walls and returns the observation and an info dict
A reset draws one spawn area, x and y uniformly inside it and the yaw uniformly in [-pi, pi]
NavigationTrack reports an empty info dict
The track model is TRACK1, twelve wall segments and six spawn areas

determinism.notes: reset(seed) fixes the spawn pose and every Gaussian draw of the following steps, so one implementation repeats a trajectory for the same seed and actions; this package's fake draws with Python's random.Random and upstream with numpy's generator, so a seed gives different trajectories on the two.  timestep_ms is 0: the analytic model declares no step interval.

gaps: kinematic/analytic model: no forces, contacts, friction or actuator dynamics; a step moves the pose by the action's fixed distance and angle plus Gaussian noise
no wall-clock pacing and no declared time step: timestep_ms 0, ticks count transitions and simulated time is not defined
five ideal ray-cast ranges with additive Gaussian sensor noise: no beam width, occlusion or reflectance model, and the scan is not clamped to its declared observation bounds
no rendering: upstream draws a pygame window only with render_mode='human'
no physical device is modelled and the model was never validated against one

the fake backend restates track 1 in pure Python with random.Random and was not compared with the upstream environment (gymnasium, numpy and pygame were not importable where the gate ran); trajectories can differ from upstream's numpy random stream
snapshot and restore are not offered: the environment exposes no get_state or set_state

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the world state is kept and stays readable
